hypotheses.I1_family_input_metric_is_concentrated: The top 32 input directions contain at least 50 percent of the family-bank top-output interaction energy for every leave-one-pair-out bank.
hypotheses.I2_family_input_eigenspace_is_specific: At rank 32, correct-family input overlap exceeds global overlap by at least 0.05 and best-wrong-family overlap by at least 0.10 in median.
hypotheses.I3_input_concentration_exceeds_coordinat: Observed top-32 input energy exceeds the median sign and pairing null by at least 0.05 in median.
hypotheses.I4_top32_input_modes_causally_recover_co: Correct top-32 input modes reach at least 0.50 median downstream fidelity to the exact family-bank top-output patch on both corpora.
hypotheses.I5_top32_input_modes_beat_random: Correct top-32 input modes exceed a fixed random rank-32 input subspace by at least 0.20 core-patch fidelity on both corpora.
hypotheses.I6_top32_input_modes_are_family_specific: Correct top-32 input modes exceed both global and observationally strongest wrong-family input modes by at least 0.10 core-patch fidelity on both corpora.
hypotheses.I7_top64_input_modes_nearly_recover_core: Correct top-64 input modes reach at least 0.75 core-patch fidelity on both corpora.
hypotheses.I8_input_mode_effect_transfers_ood: TinyStories top-32 core-patch fidelity retains at least 75 percent of FineWeb fidelity.
